title: 주말에 뭐 해요? 쉬거나 영화를 봐요
objective: By the end, you can join two verbs or adjectives with -거나 to say "A or B" about your daily life, and use (이)나 instead when the choices are nouns.
summary: Learn to use -거나 to talk about choosing one action or state from two or more, and how it differs from noun + (이)나.

task.title: Choose, fill in, and write
task.line: Read each item, then pick, fill in, fix, or write the form with -거나 or (이)나.

forms.when: With action verbs. Add 거나 to the stem, whether it ends in a consonant or not.
forms.means: "do A or do B": you do one of these (sometimes one, sometimes the other).
forms.exampleMeaning: On weekends, I rest at home or meet friends.

forms.form: Stem with a final consonant + 거나
forms.when: Stems like 먹-, 읽-, 찾-. No 으 is added: just 거나.
forms.exampleMeaning: In the morning, I eat bread or drink milk.

forms.when: With descriptive words (adjectives) to give two possible states.
forms.means: "if it is A or B": either state.
forms.exampleMeaning: If you are tired or sick, go home early.

forms.when: When the choices are nouns, not -거나. Use 이나 after a consonant and 나 after a vowel.
forms.exampleMeaning: For lunch, I eat gimbap or ramyeon.

watchOut: 커피거나 차를 마셔요 (X) → 커피나 차를 마셔요 (O): With nouns, use (이)나, not -거나.
먹으거나 (X) → 먹거나 (O): Never add 으 before 거나, even after a consonant.
어제 운동했거나 책을 읽었어요 (X) → 어제 운동하거나 책을 읽었어요 (O): Put the past tense only on the last verb.
책을 읽거나 잤어요 (X, if you did both) → 책을 읽고 잤어요 (O): -거나 means "or" (one of them). For "and" (both), use -고.
exercises: Choose the correct word: ① 심심할 때 음악을 (듣거나 / 듣으거나) 게임을 해요. ② 생일에 (꽃이나 / 꽃거나) 케이크를 선물해요. ③ 비가 오면 택시를 (타거나 / 타나) 지하철을 타요.
Fill in the blank with -거나, using the word in brackets: 날씨가 ____ 비가 오는 날에는 집에 있어요. (춥다)
Fill in the blank with -거나 or (이)나, using the words in brackets: ① 아침에는 ____ 밥을 먹어요. (떡) ② 주말에는 ____ 등산을 해요. (자전거를 타다)
Join the two sentences into one with -거나: 저녁에 요리를 해요. / 저녁에 밖에서 사 먹어요.
Find the mistake and fix it: ① 어제는 텔레비전을 봤거나 낮잠을 잤어요. ② 주스거나 물을 주세요. ③ (I did both.) 손을 씻거나 밥을 먹었어요.
Answer in Korean with -거나: 시간이 있을 때 보통 뭐 해요?
answers: ① 듣거나 ② 꽃이나 ③ 타거나
저녁에 요리를 하거나 밖에서 사 먹어요.
① 봤거나 → 보거나 ② 주스거나 → 주스나 ③ 씻거나 → 씻고
Sample answer: 시간이 있을 때 산책하거나 친구하고 전화해요. (Other answers are fine if they use verb stem + 거나 + a second verb.)
